text:
Nora: SOS 1pm standup was accompanied by what sounded like a small lawnmower. roommate vacuumed, conference turned into a techno remix. anyone built a legit "desk fort" that actually works? :sos:
Tom: duvet + two bookshelf towers + binder clips. leave a little breathing hole so it doesn't feel like a coffin. also hang a towel around desk legs for vibration.
Ivy: pro tip: move mic off the desk onto a padded hardcover book. desk table-bass is real. and enable background noise suppression in your video app if it has one.
Nora: doing the book trick now. my upload also dipped mid-call. speedtest: ```
Ping 31 ms
Download 12.7 Mbps
Upload 0.7 Mbps
```
Alex: upload under 1 is rough for video. if you can, tether phone 5G as backup or ask roommate for a 15-min vacuum window during lunch. bribe with cookies. :cookie:
Tom: if you're on ISP modem-router, you can often plug a travel router into it and run the travel router as the Wi-Fi AP (gives you QoS). worst-case, power cycle the modem first, then router.
wifi-bot: Report: Outage detected earlier in your area (ticket #OUT-2026-881). Provider ETA: 1923465000.
Nora: of course there's an outage. thanks everyone, building duvet fort now. will post incriminating photos.
Ivy: mandatory: include a dramatic vacuum-face cameo. :camera_with_flash:
Alex: and if fort fails, pretend it's ASMR for the meeting. keeps morale up.
Nora: noted. updates incoming (photos + maybe a heroic tether rescue).
